description: Ministry of Defence - Amendment to the Consolidated List under Regulation 4(2)(B) United Nations Regulations No. 02 of 2012
reasoning: The gazette content is a notification of amendments to a consolidated list of designated persons under the United Nations Regulations. It pertains to the legal and regulatory implementation of international sanctions (UN Security Council resolutions) into domestic law via "THE UNITED NATIONS ACT, NO. 45 OF 1968." The core subject is the modification of a legal list, which falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5): "New laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations," "Legal amendments," and "Regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." While it is signed by a government official, the content does not concern government structure, personnel changes, or portfolio assignments; it is purely a regulatory update.
